summary: Workspaces the user may open (multi-role launch screen)

access.who: any logged-in user, for their own account (also before a forced password change where allowed)

description:
The workspaces of the user's active roles and, for every user with an employee record, My Workspace
(`self_service`, `every_employee` true, `roles` empty unless the role employee_self is held: workflow §6.5); a guest
login (the PHC inspector) has only its role's. One role workspace: open it directly, My Workspace from the user's
menu; several: the launcher (workflow §11.1). Each window sends its workspace as `X-Active-Workspace`; one not listed
here is refused.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: The user's roles that open this workspace (empty for My Workspace when no role lands there: every employee has it)

every_employee.title: Every Employee
every_employee.description: True for My Workspace (self_service): every user with an employee record has it, whatever their roles. Open it like any workspace (its window sends X-Active-Workspace: self_service), but do not count it for the launcher: a user with one role workspace opens that one directly and reaches My Workspace from the user's menu

server_time.title: Server Time
server_time.description: Server clock (UTC). Use it to detect terminal clock skew.

data.label: PHC Inspector (read-only)
data.description: The Punjab Healthcare Commission's inspector, on a guest login for the days of the inspection (role phc_inspector, the one permission msds.inspect): the hospital's category, the MSDS indicators, the inspection pack and the web portal (CPSA) documents, all read-only; never a patient's chart, money, staff files or the hospital's internal preparation.
